findings.title: Managed certificate uses create_before_destroy with a static name, so changing domains fails on a name collision
findings.explanation: managed.domains forces replacement, and create_before_destroy creates the new certificate before deleting the old one, but both are named "${var.name}-cert", so the create fails with an already-exists error and the domain change cannot be applied. Best-fit principle reliability (apply-time correctness).
findings.remediation: Make the name unique per domain set, e.g. append a short hash of the sorted domains.

findings.title: Non-serverless NEG backends pass validation but get a USE_NAMED_PORT health check that cannot target NEGs
findings.explanation: var.backends accepts any network endpoint group, and with serverless_backends = false the module attaches an HTTPS health check with port_specification = USE_NAMED_PORT and a named port. Named ports do not apply to zonal/internet NEGs (they need USE_SERVING_PORT, RATE balancing and, for internet NEGs, no health check), so such a configuration plans but fails at apply or never becomes healthy.
findings.remediation: Restrict backends to instance groups when serverless_backends is false, and to regional serverless NEGs when it is true.
